newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds ended firmer, boosted by continuing uncertainty about plans for the single European currency, and by a statement from the Swiss National Bank that it would remain generous with liquidity.

"We will take care that the market remains very liquid," and SNB spokesman said upon release of the bank's 10-day statement, which also showed sight deposits rising by 6.6 million Swiss francs to 3.78 billion. With respect to European and Economic Monetary Union (EMU), the market remained nervous ahead of a European summit in Amsterdam on June 16 and 17.

Swiss first quarter gross domestic product data are also due on Thursday. Economists forecast a rise of 0.3 percent versus a weak fourth quarter, and a decline of 0.3 percent versus first quarter 1996.
Comi medium-term bond COMIc1 up 14 at 111.99
Euro Swiss francs FESc1 up 14 at 98.67.
